mapper.insert: INSERT INTO site_refresh_tokens ( user_id, token_hash, expires_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{tokenHash}, #{expiresAt}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, token_hash AS tokenHash, expires_at AS expiresAt, created_at AS createdAt, revoked_at AS revokedAt FROM site_refresh_tokens WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at > NOW() LIMIT 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM site_refresh_tokens WHERE expires_at <= NOW() OR revoked_at IS NOT NULL
